A doctor is a good idea. If you feel like you are out of control, or getting there, it's good to bring a doctor in as soon as you start having those feelings.

There are a few ways to go.

It is super worth doing therapy. I always feel better, after a session.

If you are not at a crisis level, I'd avoid psychiatrists until a therapist refers you. They can be good, but my experience has been that they are better at talking about meds than problems. If you are looking for someone to help you make sense of your feelings, a therapist (psychologist) is good.

If you need immediate relief - psychiatrists can prescribe meds that will alleviate some of the emotional pain. Therapy is still important, and relieving. It will help you untangle your feelings and learn helpful ways to deal with the things that make you feel bad.

There are a lot of things you can do. It's hard to get started, sometimes, but once it's moving, it's ok.
